# Human-only blockers

No human-only blockers are currently verified.

The automation is authorized to perform all normal collection, repository,
branch, pull-request, exact-head CI dispatch and wait, self-review,
squash-merge, production publication, public verification, and closeout
steps. Add an item here only when an external system truly requires a
human-only action or a required permission is absent. Include the exact
blocked action, evidence, impact, and smallest human action needed. Remove
resolved items in the next pull request.
